contract.purpose: Remove accidental Reasonix branding drift from MAGRA user-facing runtime and dashboard surfaces.
contract.scope: CLI text, dashboard about/feedback links, source banners, and related release-surface tests.

invariants.invariant-1: MAGRA is primary name in user-facing help, dashboard about, and feedback surfaces.
invariants.invariant-2: Reasonix remains only in explicit attribution or compatibility contexts.
